confman.detailedDescription: Online Meetings get more important every day, the pandemic only increased the transition speed like gasoline. Many of us have dozen of Online Meetings. Some store the access Data in small text files or add them to their Calendar events, but there is no organized, beautiful and synchronized way of combining the access data to all sorts of Meeting Tools in one App. That's what this app offers. Save your various Meetings in this app and it will be synchronized across all your devices and, with a simple click, you join them as easily as ever.

expoll.detailedDescription: Expoll is a voting website similar to other well-known voting/polling websites. We tried to combine both in a neat small and easy-to-use website. Unlike the well-known platforms, who delete polls after a quite short time, or where you have to be logged in with an active session to even get the chance to vote for something withing a few minutes, we are trying to keep every vote possible. It is also available as an iOS and self-hostable, instructions are available via the git repository.

eclipsetabs.detailedDescription: A simple Firefox extension that replaces the default bookmark system with a more modern approach. Bookmarks are stored in a tree structure and can be linked to open tabs, easily hidden with one simple click and reorganized by dragging them around. Each window can be saved as a session and restored later. The extension also offers a search function and the ability to import and export bookmarks.

soundshelf.detailedDescription:
Organize hypnosis sessions and guided audio—your way. 
This app is designed to help you manage hypnosis files, guided sessions, and spoken audio with clarity and structure. Instead of scrolling through endless filenames, you can tag, filter, and group your audio exactly how you need it. 
Perfect for Hypnosis & Guided Audio
Hypnosis libraries often grow quickly and come in many variations—inductions, deepeners, themes, voices, and session lengths. With this app, you can:
• Tag sessions by topic, voice, duration, or technique
• Create playlists for daily routines, sleep sessions, or specific goals
• Instantly filter your library using multiple tags
Core Features
• Flexible audio import
Add files via the Files app, share audio directly into the app, or copy files into the app’s folder.
• Custom tagging system
Create your own tags to organize hypnosis sessions, meditations, or any spoken audio.
• Dynamic playlists
Build playlists that automatically update based on selected tags.
• iCloud sync
Your audio files, tags, and playlists stay in sync across all your devices.
• Privacy-first
Your audio stays private in iCloud—no accounts, no streaming, no tracking.
While it’s ideal for organizing hypnosis and guided sessions, the app also works great for audiobooks, lectures, recordings, and music files.

qubepuzzle.detailedDescription: Qube Puzzle is a 2D/3D puzzle game where the player has to solve various puzzles by manipulating cubes in a 3D space. The game features multiple levels with increasing difficulty, requiring players to think critically and spatially to complete each challenge. This game was developed as a project during my studies in a group of fellow students. The focus was on creating a small simple prototype in C++ using SDL2 for rendering and input handling.
